description: EPCIS 2.0 ErrorDeclaration describing corrections to previously captured events.

declarationTime.description: The date and time at which the declaration of error is made.

reason.description:
Reason for the error.

Use  {@link  EpcisErrorReasonTypes }  for known values.

correctiveEventIDs.description: (Optional) If present, indicates that the events having the specified URIs as the value of their eventID fields are to be considered as "corrections" to the event declared erroneous by this event.
